review_candidates.title: Senior Cash Management Analyst
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities: Perform timely and accurate cash applications for customer payments and apply payments to customer accounts in the accounting system. Ensure compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements related to cash management processes, including segregation of duties, authorization limits, and anti-fraud measures. This is a secondary accountability to the role’s core cash/treasury responsibilities, not a co-ownership of the Accounting Lead’s full workload. Requirements
eligibility_evidence: For a very well-known Multinational Company located in Cairo,Egypt, a Senior Cash Management Analyst in needed.
7+ years of progressive experience spanning treasury/cash management and general ledger or GL analyst roles, preferably in a manufacturing or multinational company.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Ensure compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements related to cash management processes, including segregation of duties, authorization limits, and anti-fraud measures. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field. 7+ years of progressive experience spanning treasury/cash management and general ledger or GL analyst roles, preferably in a manufacturing or multinational company.
